head: TASK-39573bf3e443
criteria: mods/ank/lib/ exports functions turning the --json output of ank status, find --status open, review, graph and context (contract 1) into plain view models, rejecting any other contract with a typed incompatibility; node --test covers each with fixtures captured from ank 0.9.5 in tests/fixtures/, including an empty corpus and a corpus with a claimed, a blocked and a proposed entity.

constraints.title: Panel follows the focused terminal's repo
constraints.constraint: The panel shows the ank repo that contains the focused terminal's cwd; when that cwd is in no ank repo, it keeps showing the last repo it showed.

constraints.title: Refresh on folder events, never on a timer
constraints.constraint: The mod refreshes only on watchFolder events on the repo's .ank/ folder and its git refs/ank folder, or on a change of focused repo; it never polls.

constraints.title: Pure logic in lib, tested with node
constraints.constraint: Everything that does not draw or call herdr (parsing ank JSON, sorting, the blocked_by tree, repo resolution, command and prompt building) lives in mods/ank/lib/ with no import of herdr, gpui-kit or gpui-base, and is covered by node --test in tests/.

constraints.title: Corpus read only through ank --json
constraints.constraint: The ank mod reads the corpus only by running ank <verb> --json and accepting contract 1; it never parses .ank/ files or git refs itself.

constraints.title: The mod writes only ank accept
constraints.constraint: The mod never runs ank claim, done, release, log, close or amend; its only writing command is ank accept, run on the default branch at the person's click. Starting work opens a tab whose first message asks the agent to claim the task itself.

constraints.title: Repo laid out like the Herdr config home
constraints.constraint: The repo root mirrors the Herdr config home: layouts/ank.json and mods/ank/, with RECIPE.md and preview.png at the root, and the repo carries the topics herdr-layout and herdr-mod.

constraints.title: Plain Herdr look
constraints.constraint: The mod and the layout use only the colors and fonts of the person's Herdr theme; no custom theme, color override or font ships in this repo.

warnings: active claim on TASK-3957, execution context (release to explore elsewhere)
